intermediateStations: Twelve frozen adjacent compositions; not additional identities or sixteen independent workers.
unitOfInvocation: One bounded task or unchanged continuing assignment; not one new worker per shell command or file read.

bootstrap.purpose: Discover the current mandatory invocation contract and invoke the correct existing function before substantive task work.

required: frozen bearing and participating canonical identities
assignment.opposingFunctions: Separate assignments and decisions under OSL-1; preserve independent review.
assignment.continuation: Reuse an actual invoked task only while its head, scope, authority and lifecycle assignment remain applicable; record a native followup for changed assignment.

requiredCompletionProof: independent native observer and source readback

mustName: completed output or exact unresolved boundary

closureRequires: Actual post-adoption tasks use canonical native assignments and independent source readback
Host or connector enforcement denies unmediated work or a bounded enforcement claim explicitly excludes those channels

startupDiscovery.purpose: Find an actually exposed native spawn or applicable followup capability before substantive repository work.
steps: Inspect the tool definitions directly advertised to this room for a native spawn or applicable existing-task followup capability; these definitions need not appear in a deferred registry.

If the needed capability is not yet found, inspect any actually advertised deferred discovery facility, including ALL_TOOLS or tool search when present. Do not invent a discovery API or infer absence from one registry alone.

Use an available capability through its advertised namespace and argument schema. An existing applicable worker may receive a native followup; otherwise use native spawn. Do not wait for a deferred-registry match to use a directly exposed tool.
Freeze the bounded canonical assignment before invocation. Retain the actual returned task identity and invocation source event; discovering a callable tool is not invocation or completion proof.
If the call fails, preserve its exact callable name, source event and returned error. Classify the failed call separately from incomplete discovery or a capability not exposed by this host.

namespacePolicy.rule: When collaboration tools are advertised directly, call them directly outside functions.exec; do not invent tools.collaboration or tools.spawn_agent aliases. Other hosts must use their own actually advertised callable names.

NATIVE_AGENT_TOOL_AVAILABLE.condition: An applicable native callable is actually exposed by a direct or advertised deferred tool surface.
NATIVE_AGENT_TOOL_AVAILABLE.next: Freeze the assignment and actually invoke it.

NATIVE_AGENT_DISCOVERY_INCOMPLETE.condition: The required callable is not found and an advertised discovery surface remains uninspected or failed to return inspectable results.
NATIVE_AGENT_DISCOVERY_INCOMPLETE.next: Inspect the remaining available surface within bootstrap; preserve discovery errors. Do not declare capability absence or start substantive work.

NATIVE_AGENT_CAPABILITY_UNEXPOSED.condition: All advertised direct tool definitions and available deferred discovery surfaces have been inspected successfully; none exposes the required native invocation capability.
NATIVE_AGENT_CAPABILITY_UNEXPOSED.next: Report NATIVE_AGENT_INVOCATION_UNAVAILABLE_STOP_SUBSTANTIVE_WORK with the observed tool boundary. Repository text cannot attach missing host tools.

NATIVE_AGENT_INVOCATION_CALL_FAILED.condition: An actually exposed native invocation callable was called and failed.
NATIVE_AGENT_INVOCATION_CALL_FAILED.next: Preserve the exact failure and stop the unresolved substantive assignment; do not relabel the call as capability absence or substitute direct unassigned work.

requiredObservations: advertised deferred discovery inspected or not advertised or failed
actual applicable callable name and namespace when found
exact discovery or invocation failure and source event when present
actual returned native task identity and invocation event before work

complementaryOfficeDiscovery.purpose: Discover the existing whole-estate offices when the bounded task needs their capabilities or a full integrated-route claim; this is orientation, not a second runtime or authority transfer.
resolutionSteps: First invoke the appropriate canonical native function using the public bootstrap. The invoked task may discover complementary offices only when its objective or controlling contract makes them applicable.
Resolve current private main through authorized connected access, read the private AI_ENTRYPOINT.json and AGENTS.md at that exact head, then read the three source contracts at the same head.

Treat this office list and observed head as discovery pointers. Current private contracts govern their own scope; public metadata grants no private execution, mutation, scientific, merge, deployment or cross-repository authority.
Preserve identity, office, capability, stage, backend and authority distinctions. The offices are not extra cardinal identities or a requirement to invoke every office on every task.

If required private access, exact head or source contracts cannot be read, report REQUIRED_PRIVATE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and stop that dependent step; do not reconstruct private authority or block unrelated authorized public work.

Before claiming the full integrated route, check current source requirements and actual operation evidence. Local invocation success or this map alone cannot prove full-route traversal or untouched devices.
